page.intro: This page lists the installed components (Jahia and its modules) that have an update fixing a security problem, from the security data that the stores publish.

advisory.definition: A message published about a security problem in Jahia or in a module. It says which versions have the problem and which version fixes it.

cve.definition: A public number given to a known security problem, such as CVE-2026-1234. Its link opens the record of the problem on cve.org.

store.definition: A server that offers Jahia modules and publishes their security data, such as the Jahia Store (store.jahia.com). The stores checked come from Manage modules and from the settings below.

catalogue.definition: The list of the modules and versions that a store offers. This page uses it to tell whether an update works with your Jahia version.

page.error: The security report could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
page.updateError: The security report could not be updated: the last report loaded is shown. Reload the page to try again.
page.refreshing: Checking the stores… This can take a few minutes.
page.running: A check is running. This page updates when it ends.
page.notRefreshed: A check ran a moment ago, so no new check was started. Try again in a minute.
page.refreshError: The check failed, or the server stopped answering. Try again, or see the Jahia log.
page.refreshSlow: The check is still running. Reload this page in a few minutes to see the results.
page.lastSuccess: Last check that reached every store
page.empty: No known security update for this Jahia.

page.filteredEmpty: No Jahia advisory concerns this Jahia, but module owners have reported problems. Select "All, including reports by module owners" to see them.
page.afterTable: To update a module, open <manage>Manage modules</manage> and install the recommended version. To update Jahia itself, follow the <upgrade>Jahia upgrade documentation</upgrade>.

status.NOT_CHECKED: No check has run yet. The first check runs about one minute after startup. Use "Check now" to run it at once.
status.DISABLED: Checks are turned off, so this page shows no results and no banner is shown. A server administrator can turn them on in the settings below.
status.PARTIAL: Some stores could not be checked: this list may be incomplete.
status.PARTIAL_EMPTY: Some stores could not be checked. The stores that answered report no security update for this Jahia, but the others might.
status.UNAVAILABLE: No security data could be read, so this page cannot tell whether this Jahia needs security updates.
status.NOT_PUBLISHED: The Jahia Store does not publish security data yet. There is nothing to configure: this page will show results once the data is published.
status.NOT_PUBLISHED_OTHER: The store addresses checked have no security data yet. Check them in the settings below or in Manage modules. If they are right, this page will show results once the data is published.
status.STALE: The results may be out of date: no check has reached every store since {{date}}.

errors.title: Problems found during the last check

errorKind.NOT_UNDERSTOOD: Security data in an unsupported format
errorKind.CATALOGUE_UNAVAILABLE: Module list unavailable, so compatibility is unknown

errorHelp.NOT_PUBLISHED: There is nothing to configure: results will appear once the data is published.
errorHelp.NOT_UNDERSTOOD: The store sent data that this module cannot read.
errorHelp.INVALID_URL: Check the address of this store.
errorHelp.CATALOGUE_UNAVAILABLE: Findings are still listed, without their compatibility.
errorHelp.MALFORMED_VERSION: The version of this component cannot be compared with the security data.
errorHelp.NO_STORE: Add a store in Manage modules, or enter a default store address in the settings below.
errorHelp.STALE: Run a check, or see the other problems listed here.

errorDetail.NOT_HTTPS: The address does not use https. Only https addresses are accepted: change it in the settings below or in Manage modules.
errorDetail.SSRF_BLOCKED: Jahia blocked this address because it points to an internal network. If this store is internal on purpose, a system administrator can allow its host with the jahia.httpClient.allowedInternalHosts property.
errorDetail.TIMEOUT: The store did not answer in time. Try again later.
errorDetail.CONNECTION: Jahia could not connect to the store. Check the address, and the network and proxy settings of the server.
errorDetail.REDIRECT: The store answered with a redirection, which is not followed. Use the final address of the store.
errorDetail.AUTH: The store refused the user name or password. Check them in Manage modules.
errorDetail.HTTP_STATUS: The store answered with an error. Try again later.
errorDetail.TOO_LARGE: The store sent more data than allowed.
errorDetail.INVALID_JSON: The store sent data that could not be read.
errorDetail.SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED: The store uses a newer data format. Update the security-updates module to read it.
errorDetail.ENTRIES_SKIPPED: Some entries could not be read and were skipped.
errorDetail.FORGE_SETTINGS_UNREADABLE: The stores configured in Manage modules could not be read. See the Jahia log.
errorDetail.CHECK_FAILED: The check failed. See the Jahia log.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Changes are saved in the Jahia configuration, for every server of the cluster. Banner changes apply at once. After a change to the checks, the next check runs about one minute later.
settings.loadError: The settings could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
settings.readOnly: Only server administrators can change these settings. They are shown here for information.

enabled.label: Check the stores for security updates
enabled.help: When turned off, no store is checked: this page shows no results, and no banner is shown.

refreshIntervalHours.label: Hours between two checks
refreshIntervalHours.help: A whole number of hours, from 1 to 720 (30 days). After a change, the next check runs about one minute later.

useForgeSettings.label: Use the stores of Manage modules
useForgeSettings.help: Checks the stores configured in Manage modules, with their user names and passwords.

defaultStoreUrl.label: Default store address
defaultStoreUrl.help: Checked when no store comes from Manage modules. An https address, for example https://store.jahia.com. Leave it empty to check no default store.

extraFeedUrls.label: Other security data addresses
extraFeedUrls.help: Addresses of other security data files to check, for example from a partner. Separate them with commas, spaces or new lines. At most 10 https addresses, without user name or password.

bannerEnabled.label: Show the banner
bannerEnabled.help: Shows a banner on every page of the Jahia interface to the users who can open this page.

bannerMinimumSeverity.label: Lowest severity counted by the banner
bannerMinimumSeverity.help: Components whose updates are less severe are not counted.

bannerIncludeOwnerReports.label: Count the reports of module owners
bannerIncludeOwnerReports.help: When turned off, only Jahia advisories are counted.

bannerBackgroundColor.label: Banner background colour
bannerBackgroundColor.help: A colour code such as #1B1B1B. The contrast with the text colour must be at least 7 to 1: the highest accessibility level (WCAG AAA).

bannerTextColor.label: Banner text colour
bannerTextColor.help: A colour code such as #FFFFFF. Also used for the link, the button and the focus outline.

bannerDismissPolicy.label: After a user hides the banner
bannerDismissPolicy.help: Except with "Cannot be hidden", the banner comes back as soon as a new advisory or a new component is counted.

bannerDismissHours.label: Hours the banner stays hidden
bannerDismissHours.help: A whole number from 1 to 720, used only with "Hidden for a number of hours".
bannerDismissHours.disabled: Not used now: choose "Hidden for a number of hours" above to set it.

dismiss.SESSION: Hidden until the browser tab is closed
dismiss.HOURS: Hidden for a number of hours
dismiss.UNTIL_CHANGE: Hidden until a new advisory or a new component is counted

settings.resetDoneNow: Default settings restored. They apply at once.
settings.invalid: Some settings are not valid: nothing was saved. See the fields marked with an error.

resetConfirm.title: Reset every setting to its default value?
resetConfirm.body: Your current settings, including the store addresses and the banner colours, will be replaced by the default values. This cannot be undone.
